lines.en: label day14:
scene futabaoffice0
And so comes the end of another[school] day.
lines.zh: 于是，又一个[school]的日子结束了。

lines.en: Today was...
lines.zh: 今天嘛……

lines.en: Well, let's just say it was a little different than what I'm used to.
lines.zh: 嗯，只能说跟我习惯的不太一样。

lines.en: I've obviously known about Yumi's habits when it comes to bullying some of the other girls but, up until today, I figured that was only a thing she did when I wasn't around.
lines.zh: 我当然早就知道 Yumi 有欺负其他女生的习惯，但直到今天之前，我都以为她只在我看不见的时候才干这种事。

lines.en: As it turns out, she could not care less about that and is perfectly open to insulting everyone even with an authority figure ten feet away from her.
lines.zh: 事实证明，她根本不在乎，哪怕一个当权者就站在十英尺开外，她也照样毫不避讳地羞辱所有人。

lines.en: Of course, her target today wound up being the one she spends so much time on that it could practically be considered a hobby- Futaba.
lines.zh: 当然，她今天的目标不出所料还是那个她花时间最多、几乎可以算作业余爱好的对象——Futaba。

lines.en: I was so shocked by Yumi's brazenness that I wasn't even able to step in to try and stop her right away- prompting Makoto to speak up instead because she is a better teacher than me.
lines.zh: Yumi 的厚颜无耻让我震惊到甚至没能立刻出面阻止——反倒是 Makoto 先开了口，因为她是个比我更称职的老师。

lines.en: I did, however, tell Yumi to come to my office after class so I can...do something that I haven't quite figured out yet.
lines.zh: 不过我确实让 Yumi 下课后到我办公室来，好让我……做点我还没想明白的事。

lines.en: But seeing as it's been thirty minutes since the final bell rang and she still hasn't knocked, I'm beginning to think that won't be happening.
lines.zh: 但既然最后一次铃响已经过去三十分钟，她还没来敲门，我开始觉得这事八成不会发生。

lines.en: Or maybe she just has a horrible grasp on the concept of time.
lines.zh: 又或者，她对时间这概念的理解烂得要命。

lines.en: : Sensei? May I come in?
lines.zh: : Sensei？我可以进来吗？

lines.en: Or maybe it's not her at all and she really just...isn't coming.
lines.zh: 又或者根本不是她，而她真的……不会来了。

lines.en: : Sure. The door is open.
lines.zh: : 当然。门开着。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice1
: Uhm...good afternoon.
lines.zh: : 呃……下午好。

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba. I didn’t expect to see you today.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba。没想到今天会见到你。

lines.en: : Well, I...wasn't really expecting to come today, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……其实也没打算今天来，不过……

lines.en: : If this is about the Yumi thing, I feel like I should warn you that there is a very small chance she might show up while you're here.
lines.zh: : 如果是为了 Yumi 那件事，我觉得该提醒你，你在这儿的时候她有很小的可能会出现。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice2
: I...saw her leaving school, so...I don't think that's going to be happening...
lines.zh: : 我……看见她离开学校了，所以……我觉得应该不会发生……

lines.en: : Ah. Well, that explains why I only called it a small chance. I figured something like that might happen given the type of person she is.
lines.zh: : 啊。嗯，那正好解释了为什么我只说「很小的可能」。我就猜到以她那种人，可能会出这种状况。

lines.en: : Is this...a bad time?
lines.zh: : 现在……方便吗？

lines.en: : Considering my only appointment was just cancelled, nope. Take whatever time you need. I've got nothing else going on.
lines.zh: : 既然我唯一的预约刚被取消了，不方便才怪。你想待多久都行。我也没别的事。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice3
: I won't be long...
lines.zh: : 我不会待太久……

lines.en: : I'm just...a little upset and...thought that talking about it might help.
lines.zh: : 我只是……有点难过，而且……觉得说出来可能会好受一点。

lines.en: : And Rin has work today, so...I couldn't go to her instead. I'm sorry if that's an inconvenience.
lines.zh: : 而且 Rin 今天要打工，所以……我没法去找她。要是给你添麻烦了，我很抱歉。

lines.en: : You know, I actually tried talking to Yumi last week about this and-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我上周其实为这事找 Yumi 谈过了，然后——

lines.en: : And she probably just shrugged it off, right?...
lines.zh: : 然后她大概只是不当回事地耸耸肩，对吧？……

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, sorry. I'm sure you've heard all of that before.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，抱歉。你肯定早就听腻这些了。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice4
: Oh! I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to interrupt you! It's just...like you said, I've...already heard this before...
lines.zh: : 啊！对不起！我不是有意打断你的！只是……就像你说的，这些我……早就听过了……

lines.en: : But...you don't have to apologize just because I'm too sensitive, Sensei. You didn't do anything wrong at all.
lines.zh: : 不过……你不必因为我太敏感就道歉，Sensei。你根本没有做错任何事。

lines.en: : Either way, I'm sorry that this keeps happening to you.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我很抱歉这种事一直发生在你身上。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice5
: And I'm sorry to keep troubling you by coming here afterwards...
lines.zh: : 我也很抱歉，事后总跑来这儿麻烦你……

lines.en: : It's not like I'm expecting anything to change, but...just talking to an adult about it is enough to put me at ease for a little while.
lines.zh: : 我也没指望什么会改变，不过……只要能跟一个大人说说，就足够让我安心一阵子了。

lines.en: : It really helps...knowing that you're looking out for me. Even if that...doesn't really stop Yumi from doing things anyway.
lines.zh: : 知道你在护着我，真的很有帮助。哪怕那……并不能真的阻止 Yumi 继续做那些事。

lines.en: : Yeah. Well, Yumi is a fucking bitch and you should probably just ignore anything she ever says to begin with.
lines.zh: : 嗯。那个，Yumi 就是个婊子，你大概从一开始就不该把她说的任何话放在心上。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice6
: S-Sensei?
lines.zh: : S……Sensei？

lines.en: : Are you sure it's okay for you to say things like that?...
lines.zh: : 你说这种话真的没关系吗？……

lines.en: : Are you going to tell anyone I said it?
lines.zh: : 你会去跟别人说吗？

lines.en: : Well...no, but-
lines.zh: : 嗯……不会，可是——

lines.en: : Then it's fine. Besides, that girl’s been nothing but cold to me since I met her.
lines.zh: : 那就没事。再说了，那丫头从我认识她起就一直对我冷冰冰的。

lines.en: : I'm starting to doubt that there's anyone who can actually get through to her and that she won't understand what she's putting others through until she's put through something herself.
lines.zh: : 我开始怀疑，到底有没有人能真正触动她；而除非她自己也经历过同样的事，否则她根本不会明白自己让别人承受了什么。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice7
: I’m...sure she has her own problems...
lines.zh: : 我……相信她也有自己的难处……

lines.en: : For all we know...she could have already gone through more than either one of us.
lines.zh: : 说不定……她经历过的已经比我们俩任何一个都多了。

lines.en: : Sure, maybe. But that still wouldn't be an excuse for her to take everything out on you.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但那依然不能成为她把一切怨气都撒在你身上的理由。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice8
: I think...it would be less of a problem if I knew how to actually stand up for myself...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……要是我知道该怎么为自己站出来，问题就不会这么大……

lines.en: : I feel like someone else always has to step in because I’m too...cowardly to actually do anything...
lines.zh: : 我总觉得自己太……懦弱了，什么都做不了，每次都得别人替我出头……

lines.en: : This...isn't new either. I've never been good when it comes to confrontation.
lines.zh: : 这……也不是什么新鲜事了。我从来就不擅长与人正面冲突。

lines.en: : You'd think that dealing with this for so long would have...maybe prepared me or something, but...
lines.zh: : 你会以为，忍了这么久，多少该让我……有点准备什么的，但是……

lines.en: scene futabaoffice9
: I guess it's kind of hard to stand up for myself when I...don't really see anything worth standing up for?...
lines.zh: : 我想，当我觉得自己……根本没什么值得维护的东西时，要为自己站出来还挺难的吧？……

lines.en: : Does that make sense?
lines.zh: : 这说得通吗？

lines.en: : I mean...it does. But why would you feel that way? I think there's plenty about you worth defending.
lines.zh: : 嗯……说得通。可你为什么会这么想？我觉得你身上值得维护的地方多的是。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice10
Futaba focuses on the floor for a few moments as she summons the resolve to respond.
lines.zh: Futaba 盯着地板看了好一会儿，才攒起回答的决心。

lines.en: The truth is, I knew the answer to my question before I even asked it. But keeping it to myself without letting any words out into the open won't bring us closer.
lines.zh: 其实，我在问出口之前就已经知道答案了。但把它闷在心里、一个字都不说出来，并不能让我们更亲近。

lines.en: My silence would do absolutely nothing for her.
lines.zh: 我的沉默对她毫无帮助。

lines.en: The same goes for pretending to understand her...or pretending to relate.
lines.zh: 假装理解她……或者假装感同身受，也一样。

lines.en: All a person can do at a time like this is feign ignorance and gently pull the words out of someone else when they won't fall out on their own.
lines.zh: 在这种时候，一个人唯一能做的，就是装作不知道，在对方自己说不出来时，把那些话轻轻引出来。

lines.en: : Um...Well...
: I just...don’t agree with that...
lines.zh: : 我只是……不同意这种说法……

lines.en: : I...don't see myself as the type of person who's...worthy of being defended...
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得自己是那种……值得被维护的人……

lines.en: : Which makes it feel so much worse a lot of the time since everyone always has to stick up for me...
lines.zh: : 所以很多时候感觉反而更难受，因为大家总是得替我撑腰……

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: scene futabaoffice11
: I don't really like myself, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我大概……不太喜欢我自己。

lines.en: : Why, though? I think you’re great. And everyone except Yumi would probably agree.
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？我觉得你很好啊。而且除了 Yumi，大概所有人都会同意。

lines.en: : Thank you...really...But hearing something like that isn’t enough to change how I feel.
lines.zh: : 谢谢……真的……可光是听到这种话，还不足以改变我的感受。

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : It's really hard...
lines.zh: : 真的很难……

lines.en: : Looking at the other girls sometimes, I mean...
lines.zh: : 我是说，有时候看着其他女生……

lines.en: : I'm sure it sounds petty, but...I can't help but be a little jealous.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来很小家子气，可是……我忍不住会有点嫉妒。

lines.en: : If I...
lines.zh: : 如果我……

lines.en: : If I could look like Yumi...I'd be so happy...
lines.zh: : 如果我能长得像 Yumi……我会开心死的……

lines.en: : So the fact that she's always the one to point out how I don't?...
lines.zh: : 所以，偏偏总是她来指出我有多不像，这件事……

lines.en: scene futabaoffice12
: Being heavy...
lines.zh: : 胖这件事……

lines.en: : Is really hard, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 真的很难熬，Sensei……

lines.en: I honestly have no idea how I’m supposed to reply to something like this and am reminded once again of the hesitance I face when stepping into this room each day.
lines.zh: 我实在不知道该怎么回应这种话，也因此再一次意识到，自己每天踏进这间屋子时那份犹豫。

lines.en: I'm not qualified to make anyone feel better about themselves- not when, more often than not, I can't even pinpoint how I personally feel.
lines.zh: 我没有资格让任何人对自己感觉好一点——尤其当我自己常常连自己的感受都摸不清的时候。

lines.en: The natural reaction here would be...reassurance, right?
lines.zh: 这时候自然的反应应该是……安慰，对吧？

lines.en: But something about that just seems so...expected.
lines.zh: 可那样做总让人觉得太……意料之中了。

lines.en: Would the true owner of this body have more to offer than just the insistence that this person who has a hard time looking at herself should just...look a little closer?
lines.zh: 这具身体真正的主人，难道除了坚持让这个连正视自己都困难的女孩……再凑近一点看看之外，就给不出别的了吗？

lines.en: Or are all of us equally worthless when it comes to changing one's perception of themself?
lines.zh: 还是说，在改变一个人对自己的看法这件事上，我们所有人都一样无能为力？

lines.en: I don't know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: But I can't stay silent forever.
lines.zh: 但我不能永远沉默下去。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice13
: I’m sorry for being such a downer all of a sudden...I know you’re probably uncomfortable hearing something like this from me...
lines.zh: : 抱歉我突然这么丧……我知道听我说这些，你大概挺不自在的……

lines.en: : I mean...there’s no way you could honestly look at me and tell me not to worry about it. Not when you see the difference with your own eyes every single day.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你每天亲眼看着差距，不可能真心看着我说「别在意」吧。

lines.en: : Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice14
: I'm going to tell you something right now, but you're going to have to keep it between us. Got it?
lines.zh: : 我现在要跟你说一件事，不过你得保密。明白吗？

lines.en: : Um...sure. I...already expect everything that happens in here to remain confidential, so...
lines.zh: : 呃……好的。我……本来就觉得在这儿发生的一切都应该保密，所以……

lines.en: : Good.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : In that case, I find you extremely attractive.
lines.zh: : 那么，我觉得你非常有魅力。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice15
: Uhh...sorry, but...I don't think I heard you quite well...
lines.zh: : 呃……抱歉，我……好像没听太清楚……

lines.en: : That's fine. I don't mind saying it again.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我不介意再说一遍。

lines.en: : Wait. You don't-
lines.zh: : 等等。你不用——

lines.en: : I think you're extremely attractive and that the way you think about yourself is wrong.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你非常有魅力，而你对自己的看法是错的。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice16
: You...You do?!
lines.zh: : 你……你真的这么想？！

lines.en: : Yup. But again, don't tell anyone I said that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过再说一次，别跟别人说是我说的。

lines.en: : Sensei...that's...wait...
lines.zh: : Sensei……这……等等……

lines.en: : I'm...still a student! Being attracted to me would mean-
lines.zh: : 我……还是个学生啊！对我有那种感觉意味着——

lines.en: : We don't have to talk about what it means. But sitting here and listening to you talking about how you don't like yourself is tough to do when I feel the exact opposite way, you know?
lines.zh: : 我们不一定要谈它意味着什么。但当我心里的感受跟你说的完全相反时，坐在这儿听你说你有多不喜欢自己，真的很难熬，你懂吗？

lines.en: : Plus, without being too specific, I'm sure there are plenty of girls in this school that envy certain parts of you.
lines.zh: : 再说，不用说得太具体，我敢肯定这所学校里有不少女生会羡慕你身上的某些部位。

lines.en: : That's-
lines.zh: : 这太——

lines.en: : Inappropriate? Yeah, probably. But I didn't say any specifics, so all you can really do is assume and file this under some sort of gray area.
lines.zh: : 不合适？嗯，大概是。不过我又没说具体是哪里，所以你也只能自己猜，然后把这事归到某种灰色地带里。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice17
: Sensei...do you...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你真的……

lines.en: : Really think I’m pretty?...
lines.zh: : 真的觉得我好看吗？……

lines.en: : Is that weird?
lines.zh: : 这很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...I think so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得是……

lines.en: : No one’s ever looked at me like that before...let alone an adult...
lines.zh: : 从来没有人那样看过我……更别提一个成年人了……

lines.en: : I don’t...really know what to say...
lines.zh: : 我……真的不知道该说什么……

lines.en: : I mean, you don’t have to say anything. I just don’t want you to feel down on yourself anymore and...this was all I could think of saying to try and snap you out of it.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你不必说什么。我只是不想再看你这么贬低自己，而……这是我能想到的、唯一能让你振作一点的话了。

lines.en: : I'm sure it didn't do much, though. So if there's anything you want from me in the future, don't hesitate to ask.
lines.zh: : 不过我猜这也没起多大作用。所以以后你要是想要我做什么，尽管开口。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice18
: Th-Thanks! But I, umm...I think you’ve already helped me enough for now...
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢！不过我，呃……我觉得你已经帮我够多了……

lines.en: : I...probably just need a little more time to...process what I just found out, but...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我……大概只是需要多一点时间……消化一下我刚知道的事，不过……呃……

lines.en: : I'm also...
lines.zh: : 我也……

lines.en: : Attracted to you...
lines.zh: : 对你有那种感觉……

lines.en: : What was that? I couldn't hear you.
lines.zh: : 你刚说什么？我没听清。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice19
: Good. It was...extremely embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 太好了。那句话……实在太丢人了。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: scene futabaoffice20
: Umm...I really am feeling a little better now, though...
lines.zh: : 呃……不过我现在真的感觉好一点了……

lines.en: : It makes me really happy knowing you don’t look at me the same way Yumi does...
lines.zh: : 知道你看我的眼光跟 Yumi 不一样，我真的好开心……

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I don’t see anything the same way Yumi does, so I wouldn’t worry about that too much.
lines.zh: : 我敢说我看什么东西都跟 Yumi 不一样，所以你别太在意那个。

lines.en: : Heheh...I guess I’ll...try not to, then.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……那我……就尽量不去在意吧。

lines.en: : Really, though- feel free to drop by whenever you’re feeling down.
lines.zh: : 说真的——心情不好的时候随时都可以过来。

lines.en: : I accept house calls too, starting right now. I might have to charge you, though, depending on what sorts of services you're after.
lines.zh: : 我也接上门出诊，从现在就开始。不过要看你想要哪种服务，我可能得收点费。

lines.en: scene futabaoffice21
: Okay! Uhh...thank you! But I think that...your office is fine and...I...
lines.zh: : 好的！呃……谢谢！不过我觉得……在你的办公室就好，而且……我……

lines.en: : I don't know what...sorts of...services you are referring to...
lines.zh: : 我不知道你说的……是哪种……服务……

lines.en: : Would you like a list? Let me just a grab a pen and-
lines.zh: : 你想要一份清单吗？我去拿支笔——

lines.en: scene futabaoffice22
: No thank you! I'll be on my way now!
lines.zh: : 不用了谢谢！我先走了！

lines.en: : I'm sorry again for taking up so much of your time!
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉占了你这么多时间！

lines.en: : You really don't have to leave if-
lines.zh: : 你真的不用走的，如果——

lines.en: : Goodbye, Sensei! Thank you for the...information you shared with me today!
lines.zh: : 再见，Sensei！谢谢你今天……跟我分享的那些信息！

lines.en: : I promise I won't tell anyone!
lines.zh: : 我保证不会告诉任何人！

lines.en: scene futabaoffice0
: Goodbye again!
lines.zh: : 再说一次再见！

lines.en: scene black
I hope I didn't scare Futaba off by admitting to her that I've been looking at her as more than just a student.
lines.zh: 希望我向 Futaba 坦白自己不单把她当学生看，没有把她吓跑。

lines.en: I doubt she's the type to do anything malicious or...irresponsible with the information, but I guess you can't ever be too sure about anything in this life.
lines.zh: 我猜她不是那种会拿这件事去害人或者……乱来的人，不过这世上大概也没什么能打包票的事。

lines.en: At the very least, I hope she takes solace in the fact that there is someone out there fantasizing about her while continuously writing herself off as unwanted and undesirable.
lines.zh: 至少，我希望她能从这样一件事里得到慰藉：在她不断把自己看成没人要、没有吸引力的人时，这世上还有人在对她抱有幻想。

lines.en: The sadder truth, however-
lines.zh: 然而更悲哀的真相是——

lines.en: Is that I want everyone.
lines.zh: 我谁都想要。

lines.en: And that she's no more special than the rest of them.
lines.zh: 而她并不比其他人更特别。

$ day14 = True
Futaba's affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
lines.zh: Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]！

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
